version.source_version: internal v1 package (no external source dependency)

function_description: 13 模块健康观测与诊断系统：HEART 独立心跳采集；WATCH_REGISTRY 被观测对象登记；HEALTH_MODEL 六维健康度（TASK_STATE/AGENT_STATE/RUNTIME_STATE/DEPENDENCY_STATE/DATA_FRESHNESS/SERVICE_REACHABILITY，互相独立，无证据一律 UNKNOWN）；PRE_DIAGNOSIS_SNAPSHOT 诊断前冻结保证判定可复现；DIAGNOSIS 八字段诊断门（SYMPTOM/EVIDENCE/LAST_GOOD/FIRST_BAD/AFFECTED_COMPONENT/LIKELY_CAUSE/CONFIDENCE/NEXT_TEST + recovery_decision，confidence<0.6 强制 NO_RECOVERY）；INCIDENT_LEDGER 只增哈希链防篡改；DEDUP 窗口去重；RECOVERY_POLICY Finding→ActionSpec 策略表；VERIFY PRE/POST 校验；ROLLBACK 计划生成（执行需 L3+）；BACKOFF 指数退避；CIRCUIT_BREAKER 熔断；ESCALATION 仅开票不执行。权限分层 L0-L5，默认 L3+ 全关、白名单空（BUILD_COMPLETE ≠ RECOVERY_AUTHORIZED）。

evidence_sources: BUILD_REPORT.md (13 模块施工 + 21/21 测试 PASS)
